header.title: OtpInput
header.description: Segmented slots for verification codes (6 by default, any positive length). Supports pasting the whole code, keyboard navigation and fires `onComplete` once the code is full.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Verification code
playground.helperText: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.

base.title: Base
base.description: Six numeric slots. Paste the whole code into any slot.

texts.label: Verification code
texts.helperText: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your email.

withSeparator.title: With separator
withSeparator.description: `separator` sits in the middle of the slots.

texts.label: Authentication code
texts.helperText: Optional separator splits the slots in half.

alphanumeric.title: Alphanumeric
alphanumeric.description: `type="alphanumeric"` accepts letters and numbers. `uppercase` is true by default.

texts.label: Backup code
texts.helperText: Letters and numbers. uppercase is true by default.

masked.title: Masked
masked.description: `mask` hides filled slots with a disc.

texts.label: Secure code
texts.helperText: Default mask is a disc. Pass maskIcon to replace it.

maskCharacter.title: Mask character
maskCharacter.description: `maskIcon` accepts a character and also enables masking.

maskIcon.title: Mask icon
maskIcon.description: `maskIcon` also accepts any React node, such as an icon.

outlineLabel.title: Outline label
outlineLabel.description: `labelPlacement="outline"` floats the label over the slot group.

texts.label: OTP
texts.helperText: The label sits over the slot group.

withInfoIcon.title: With info icon
withInfoIcon.description: `infoText` adds an icon with a tooltip at the top-right.

texts.label: Verification code
texts.helperText: The info control sits at the top-right when infoText is set.

clearable.title: Clearable
clearable.description: `clearable` shows a button that empties the field while it has a value. It clears through the normal `onChange` path, so it works the same controlled or uncontrolled, and then fires `onClear`. `clearLabel` is the button's accessible name; it defaults to "Clear". It empties every slot and focuses the first one.

texts.label: Verification code
texts.helperText: The button shows while the field has a value.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` shows the message with role="alert" and forces the error border.

texts.label: Verification code
texts.errorMessage: The code is incorrect or has expired.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: `border` sets the tone of the slots and helper text. Forced to error when the field is invalid.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the value with value and `onChange`. `onComplete` fires once when the code reaches length.

texts.label: Controlled code
texts.helperText: Paste a 6-digit code or type one character per slot.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and circular slots with cn() on wrapperClassName.
tailwind.mergedHelper: radius-xs replaces radius-full thanks to tailwind-merge.

css.label: Branded code
css.helperText: No border, soft tertiary background and lg radius, tokens only.

header.title: OtpInput API
header.description: API reference for the OtpInput React component: props, events, CSS classes, tokens, utilities and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. OTPInput is an alias of the same component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: It does not extend native <input> attributes: it only accepts the props in the table. className goes to each slot, wrapperClassName to the container and onFocus/onBlur to the slot group. With name a <input type="hidden"> submits the full code in a form.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.group: Slots live in a role="group". The label points to the first slot; without a label, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby.
a11y.slots: Each slot has aria-label="Digit n of length" (fixed, in English) and uses inputMode="numeric" when type is numeric.
a11y.keyboard: Arrows, Home and End move focus; Backspace and Delete erase. Pasting spreads the code across the slots.
a11y.autocomplete: The first slot uses autoComplete="one-time-code" so the browser can suggest the code received by SMS.
a11y.states: isInvalid and isRequired map to aria-invalid and aria-required on each slot; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can target to override styles.

rules.clear: Clear button. Shown with `clearable` while the field has a value.
rules.label: Field label.
rules.secret: Filled slot with masking on (transparent text).
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: OtpInput has no CSS variables of its own: it uses these gem-system tokens. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-color-accent: Focus border, caret and outline label on focus.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.description: Helpers exported with the component to validate codes outside of it.

items.resolveOtpLength: Normalizes length: non-finite values fall back to 6 and values below 1 become 1.
items.sanitizeOtpValue: Strips characters not allowed by type and applies uppercase when needed.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: OtpInput props. It does not accept other native attributes.

items.length: Number of slots. Any positive integer.
items.type: Allowed characters: numbers only or letters and numbers.
items.uppercase: Forces typed, pasted and emitted values to uppercase.
items.mask: Hides filled slots with a disc.
items.maskIcon: Mask glyph: a character or any node. Also enables masking.
items.separator: Node between both halves of the slots.
items.name: Name of a hidden input that submits the full code.
items.autoFocus: Focuses the first empty slot on mount.
items.autoComplete: Autocomplete hint on the first slot.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or over the slot group.
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.isInvalid: Marks the field as invalid (aria-invalid on each slot).
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.aria-label: Accessible name of the group when there is no label.
items.clearable: Shows a button that empties the field while it has a value.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button.
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Receives the full code after every change.
items.onComplete: Fires once when the code reaches length characters.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
items.onClear: Fires after the field is cleared with the button.
